address: GF, Menara Ample West, 6 Jalan Puncak, Kuala Lumpur, 50250, Malaysia
bio: Every detail, from the imported tableware to the authentic Thai dining experience, has been pondered and puzzled over. Malai relocated to this venue at the end of 2022 to offer greater comfort and more spacious dining on two floors. It’s regularly packed with office workers, especially at lunchtime. The mostly Thai team of chefs conjures up a traditional Thai menu with modern twists. Don’t miss the tom yum soup or the gaeng keaw waan (green curry)....
